controls.title: Unique canonical ownership
controls.objective: Every canonical public domain has exactly one owning repository.

controls.title: Public/private minimization
controls.objective: The public registry contains public repositories and non-sensitive metadata only.

controls.title: Lifecycle accountability
controls.objective: Every public repository has a lifecycle, owner, DRI, risk class, disposition, and review date.

controls.title: Derived-view integrity
controls.objective: Generated portfolio views exactly reflect authoritative records.

controls.title: Least-privilege workflows
controls.objective: Workflows declare permissions and pin third-party Actions to immutable commits.

controls.title: Protected governance branch
controls.objective: Governance changes enter main only through reviewed, checked pull requests.

controls.title: Exception expiry
controls.objective: Every waiver is scoped, approved, expiring, and visible.

controls.title: Repository drift detection
controls.objective: Declared public inventory is reconciled against GitHub without becoming a second mutable status store.
controls.enforcement: scheduled read-only discovery plus one issue

controls.title: Protected authority separation
controls.objective: Governance metadata cannot grant OpenCoven runtime or protected mutation authority.
controls.enforcement: review, schemas, and architecture canaries in owning repositories

controls.title: Evidence-backed change
controls.objective: Material governance changes include machine-readable, reviewable evidence.
